test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

I have been __living without a lot of money__ since I lost my job.

options.text: as genuine as a three-dollar bill

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"living hand to mouth"** means to live in a way where you only have enough money to meet your immediate needs and nothing extra. (मुश्किल से गुज़ारा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** Ever since the economic downturn, many families have been **living hand to mouth.**
 
 
 
• **"Living without a lot of money"** refers to a situation where one has just enough money to survive without any extra for savings or luxuries. (बिना अधिक पैसे के रहना)
 
 
• **Example:** After losing his job, he found himself living without a lot of money.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom **'living hand to mouth'** appropriately substitutes the phrase** 'living without a lot of money'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Receiving a kickback** (रिश्वत लेना): Accepting a bribe or illegal payment for services rendered.

 
 
• **Example:** The politician was caught receiving a kickback from a construction company.
 
 
 
• **Keeping my chin up** (हिम्मत बनाए रखना): Staying optimistic and positive in difficult situations.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the setbacks, she is keeping her chin up and continuing to work hard.
 
 
 
• **As genuine as a three-dollar bill** (बिलकुल नकली): Something that is fake or not genuine.
 
 
• **Example:** His apology seemed as genuine as a three-dollar bill.
 
 

2f4:Tccf,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
